EQUITY TRADING

Services / Sales & Trading / Equity Trading
Equity Trading

– Extensive Regional Expertise
– High Touch Trading
– Electronic Trading
– Market Making
– ArqNeT

Arqaam Capital’s equities business centers around seamless execution via serving global institutions, high net worth individuals and family offices; focusing on regional, Frontier and Emerging markets.  Arqaam’s is a leading brokerage house in both GCC & Egypt markets while providing access to 40 exchanges globally.

We harness cutting-edge technology to deliver equity execution and connectivity solutions in MENA and globally.  Leveraging on our advanced technical infrastructure, Arqaam offers direct market access, a suite of algorithms and low latency routing services within the MENA exchanges.  Our Compliance, Security and Risk Management systems meet our institutional clients’ highest standards.

Our Sales and Trading desks boast unparalleled local knowledge and expertise. Seasoned experts provide timely market insights, allowing our clients to stay informed about market trends and news.  Additionally, our robust market share facilitates efficient block transactions.

Arqaam Network and Electronic Trading (ArqNeT), our in-house trading infrastructure has a fast point of presence out of London. Combining innovative technology, redundant networks, and market expertise, ArqNeT ensures secure, resilient, and low-latency access to both MENA and global exchanges.

Arqaam Capital offers an extensive range of algorithmic trading tools meticulously crafted to enhance trading processes. Whether navigating regional or global markets, our unified Algo suite ensures optimized outcomes for clients by improving efficiency and providing best execution.

As a prominent regional market maker, Arqaam Capital plays a vital role in fostering liquidity within the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and Egypt exchanges. Our expertise in market structure and execution technology enables us to consistently offer competitive bids and facilitate transactions across key exchanges, including the Dubai Financial Market (DFM), Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX), and Tadawul.

At Arqaam Capital, our unwavering commitment to excellence, innovation, and client success guides our mission.  We strive to provide exceptional financial services, empower our clients, and contribute to the growth and prosperity of the financial regional landscape.
